blocks.title: Welcome and agreements
blocks.notes: Introduce the fictional session. Explain respectful participation and how notes will be used.

blocks.title: Hear local perspectives
blocks.notes: Invite a range of voices. Use a visible speaking order and allow people to pass.

blocks.title: Map shared priorities
blocks.notes: Group themes on paper. Ask what is missing before choosing priorities.

blocks.title: Read back and close
blocks.notes: Read back the priorities. Explain the next meeting and how participants can correct the notes.
